data_types.date: ISO date value on the wire (dataset layer keeps typed date objects; writers format)
data_types.integer: health_score int 0..100, null when missing (missing is never 0)
data_types.string: text or null (missing LEFT relations are null, never ''/N/A/-)

defaults.columns_omitted: all 14 mandatory columns in documented order

mandatory_columns.title: ИТ-направление
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.program_id -> it_programs.direction_id -> it_directions.name (COALESCE licenses.direction_id, program direction); NULL for fallback rows

mandatory_columns.title: ИТ-программа
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.program_id -> it_programs.name (ITProgram.name); NULL for fallback rows

mandatory_columns.title: ИТ-продукт
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.product_id -> it_products.name (ITProduct.name); NULL for fallback rows

mandatory_columns.title: Статус работы
mandatory_columns.source: derived: current InstanceStage.name of the latest workflow_instances row for the university; else earliest university_programs.status (by program name); else NULL. Canonical workflow_instances + instance_stages only, never legacy workflow tables

mandatory_columns.title: Ответственный
mandatory_columns.source: derived aggregate: university_responsibles -> responsibles.full_name, sorted ascending, joined with '; ' (one row per report row, never fan-out); NULL when no links

mandatory_columns.title: Вендор
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.product_id -> it_products.vendor_id -> vendors.name (Vendor.name); NULL for fallback rows

mandatory_columns.title: ПО
mandatory_columns.source: intentional alias of product: licenses.product_id -> it_products.name (no separate software model/field exists)

mandatory_columns.title: Номер договора
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.contract_id -> contracts.contract_number for license rows; latest contracts row per university (signed_at DESC, expires_at DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) for license-less fallback rows; else NULL

mandatory_columns.title: Подписание лицензии
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.signed_at (License.signed_at, Date); NULL for fallback rows

mandatory_columns.title: Срок действия
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.expires_at (License.expires_at, Date); NULL for fallback rows

mandatory_columns.title: Статус передачи
mandatory_columns.source: licenses.transfer_status_raw for license rows (real raw field, no new enum/constraint); latest contract transfer_status_raw for license-less fallback rows; else NULL

mandatory_columns.title: Комментарий
mandatory_columns.source: COALESCE(licenses.comment, licenses.contract_id -> contracts.comment) for license rows; latest contract comment for license-less fallback rows; else NULL (both canonical comment fields exist)

mandatory_columns.title: Health Score
mandatory_columns.source: latest health_score_snapshots.score per university (ORDER BY calculated_at DESC); NULL when no snapshot; optional Python fallback via canonical calculate_health_score (P2-07-08), never a new formula. int 0..100, missing is NULL (never 0)

optional_columns_supported.title: Текущий этап
optional_columns_supported.source: current InstanceStage.name of the latest workflow_instances row (primary branch of workflow_status WITHOUT the university_programs fallback); NULL when no workflow

optional_columns_supported.title: Последнее взаимодействие
optional_columns_supported.source: frozen P4-02-02 FULL rule: latest interaction date per university = GREATEST(max(meetings.meeting_at), max(interaction_notes.created_at)); NULL when the university has neither meetings nor notes

optional_columns_supported.title: Прогресс workflow, %
optional_columns_supported.source: frozen P4-02-02 FULL rule (mirrors the Dev-2 matrix): percent of completed instance_stages over non-skipped stages across ACTIVE workflow_instances of the university, nearest integer 0..100; NULL when there are no eligible stages

optional_columns_supported.title: Готовность преподавателей, %
optional_columns_supported.source: frozen P4-02-02 FULL rule: percent of the university teachers with canonical readiness == ready (same compute_teacher_readiness as P1 passports and the Dev-2 matrix, university grain instead of per-program), nearest integer 0..100; NULL when no teachers

optional_columns_supported.title: Просроченные задачи
optional_columns_supported.source: frozen P4-02-02 FULL rule (P2 canonical overdue rule): count of workflow_tasks with status == open and deadline at least 1 day in the past on ACTIVE workflow_instances of the university; 0 when none

ordering: University.name ASC, University.id ASC, License.license_number ASC NULLS LAST, License.id ASC (deterministic, never DB natural order)
registry: backend/app/modules/analytics/columns.py (COLUMN_REGISTRY; single source of truth, never duplicated per exporter)
row_grain: one row per (University x License) via universities LEFT JOIN licenses; license-less universities produce exactly one fallback row; no programs x products x responsibles cartesian product
